answer: Deposits are visible in plume, and marble reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 37 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dune account. A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2013 identities would post 3712 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
